Continuing from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105080#discussion_r2064610472

The "_but_" here doesn't make sense. A smaller file size and **shorter** encoding speed are both good things.
Judging by what you said in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105080#discussion_r2065455944 , this may be an error:
> This option has significant impact on the encoding speed.
4x larger dict size almost makes the encoding time 2-4x longer.
```suggestion
			The dictionary size for RDO, ranging from [code]64[/code] to [code]65536[/code]. Higher values reduce the file size further, but significantly increase encoding speed.
```

There may be a bit of confusion, so just so we're clear:
- "Increase encoding speed": Makes encoding **slower**. meaning encoding takes **more** time to compute.
- "Decrease encoding speed": Makes encoding **faster**, meaning encoding takes **less** time to compute.

Given this may be a point of confusion for readers as well, perhaps it's worth spelling it out more thoroughly, too.
